title: Vaitu: pass on the jobs you can't take to a colleague
description: Booked for a job you can't do? Publish it on Vaitu: colleagues in your trade apply, and you choose who goes.
eyebrow: For people who work at events, homes and offices
headline: Can't make it? Tell a colleague: “vai tu”.
lede: Vaitu is where professionals hand off jobs they can't take. You publish the job, colleagues apply, and you choose who to pass it to.
ctaNote: Publishing, applying and choosing are free, always.
nameOrigin: The name comes from the Italian “vai tu”, “you go”: what you tell a colleague when you pass them a job.

steps.title: Publish the job
steps.body: Type the details, or describe it by voice and the fields fill in.

steps.title: Colleagues apply
steps.body: People in your trade and area get an alert, and tell you why they're right for it.

steps.title: Choose who goes
steps.body: Compare applicants, contact the one you prefer and agree the details directly.

sides.title: When you can't make it
points: Don't let your client down or lose their trust
You decide who gets the job
See each applicant's rank and reviews

sides.title: When you're looking for work
points: Choose your trades and regions, and get an alert when a job fits
Apply with a profile that's already filled in
Build a reputation made of real jobs

trust.title: Reputation earned on the job
trust.body: Points come from jobs done and organizers' reviews, not from how many times you apply.

trust.title: Your deal, your terms
trust.body: Vaitu handles no payments and takes no commission: you agree the fee and terms between yourselves.

trust.title: Contacts kept private
trust.body: Your contact details are only seen by organizers of the events you apply to.

trust.title: Report and block
trust.body: You can report content and block anyone you don't want to deal with.

earlyBody: There won't be many jobs at first. Choose your trades and regions, and we'll let you know when one fits.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Publishing a job, applying and choosing who goes are free, and always will be. Later we may add optional paid extras.

faq.question: How do we get in touch?
faq.answer: Organizers see applicants' websites and phone numbers, and contact the person they choose directly. Vaitu has no chat.

faq.question: Does Vaitu handle payments or contracts?
faq.answer: No: you agree the fee and terms between yourselves.

faq.question: My trade isn't listed. What now?
faq.answer: Write to us: we're adding new trades.

closing: The next job you can't take, pass it to a colleague.
credits: Idea by Giada Joey Cazzola. Built by Matteo Antony Mistretta.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Vaitu is run by {{owner}}, which decides how your data is used. For anything about your data, write to {{email}}.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Your email, name and password (stored encrypted). What you add to your profile: phone, website, country, photo, trades, regions and language. What you publish: events and their photos, including any client names you enter. Your applications, reviews, stats, reports and blocks. A device token for push notifications, and usage statistics only if you allow them. The pay you offer, the amounts you confirm and whether they were settled.

voice.title: Voice messages
voice.body: If you describe an event by voice, the recording is sent to our speech provider to be turned into text, and that text to an AI provider to fill in the form. We never store the recording or the text. Please avoid saying more about your clients than the job needs.

visible.title: Who sees what
visible.body: Open events are public, even to people without an account. When you apply, the organizer sees your name, contact details, message, rank, badges and reviews. Reviews are shown without the name of whoever wrote them.

providers.title: Who helps us
providers.body: Supabase and Vercel (hosting and database), Firebase by Google (push notifications and, with your consent, Google Analytics), Deepgram (speech to text), OpenRouter and the free AI models it reaches (filling in the form; these providers may keep or use what they receive), and Resend (email). Some are outside the EU, where we rely on the safeguards the law requires.

keeping.title: Why, and for how long
keeping.body: We use your data to run the service you signed up for, to keep it safe, and for statistics only with your consent. We keep it until you delete your account. Deactivating keeps it, so you can come back. Deleting removes your account, profile, files and events, while reviews and past job records stay without your name, as [Deleted User], because they are part of other people's history. We email you about your jobs and applications, and about new jobs for your trades: choose which in Preferences, or use the link in each email.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can access, correct, export or erase your data, object to its use, and withdraw consent at any time. Most of this is in the app: statistics in Preferences, deletion in your profile. For the rest, write to {{email}}. You can also complain to your data protection authority. Vaitu is for people aged 18 or over.

what.title: What Vaitu is
what.body: Vaitu, run by {{owner}}, lets professionals pass on jobs they can't take to colleagues. It only connects people: it is not an employer, agent or party to any job.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You must be at least 18 and working in a professional capacity. Keep your details accurate and your password safe. You are responsible for what happens under your account.

handoff.title: Handing off a job
handoff.body: You agree on the fee, terms and any contract between yourselves, and each of you is responsible for your own taxes, insurance and permits. Make sure you may pass on a job, and that your client agrees where needed. Vaitu handles no payments and guarantees no job, applicant or outcome. Vaitu can record an amount you both confirm, but it doesn't enforce it.

content.title: What you publish
content.body: You keep your content, and allow us to host and show it to run the service. Only publish what is true and what you have the right to share. Don't post a home's street address or more about clients than the job needs. Reviews must be honest and about the job.

moderation.title: Reports and removal
moderation.body: You can report content and block people. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms or the law.

price.title: Price and limits
price.body: Publishing a job, applying and choosing a candidate are free, and always will be. Some extras have limits, such as a daily number of voice messages, and we may offer optional paid extras. We'll tell you before we do, and you'll never have to pay to use the basics.

liability.title: Responsibility
liability.body: The service is provided as it is, and may be interrupted or change. Within the limits of the law, we are not responsible for what happens between users, or for lost work or income. Nothing here limits rights you have by law that can't be waived.

ending.title: Ending and changes
ending.body: You can delete your account at any time from your profile. We'll tell you about important changes to these terms. These terms follow Italian law. For questions, write to {{email}}.
